preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products n is less than the modulus m, and both are non-negative integers.
If n is non-zero, the list of forbidden prefix products contains n distinct integers between 0 and m - 1.

postconditions.description: The length of the sequence k is between 1 and 200000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is an integer between 0 and m - 1, inclusive.
All prefix products of the sequence modulo m are distinct.

postconditions.expression: not any(x in forbidden_prefix_products for x in prefix_products(sequence))
postconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m appears as an element of the input list of forbidden prefix products.
The length of the sequence is maximized.
